facts.claim: The Arcane Ward is a necklace-like device that weakens and reduces all magical effects directed at Devna
facts.quote: It was a small device shaped to be pretty enough to wear as a necklace, but the important part was it weakened and reduced all magical effects directed at her.

facts.claim: Devna Sorrel is human
facts.quote: Being human, if there was something wacky going on with magic she wouldn’t be paralyzed by it.

facts.claim: Devna spent more than three years in theory, technology and training for the expedition
facts.quote: After more then three years of theory and finetuning technology and training, they were finally ready.

facts.claim: Devna is Myor's partner for the expedition
facts.quote: The fact her partner was a Ratfolk was one of the better outcomes Devna hoped for.

facts.claim: Devna built the Arcane Ward as part of her thesis nearly a decade ago
facts.quote: She’d built it as part of her thesis nearly a decade ago and through tinkering had improved it over the years.

facts.claim: Devna redesigned the Home Anchor over nearly eleven months to make it durable
facts.quote: Devna knew because she had spent nearly eleven months redesigning it to ensure it wouldn’t accidentally break and strand Myor

facts.claim: Devna successfully argued the Wayfarer Sigil should have a different name from the Home Anchor
facts.quote: she had successfully argued they should have different names.

facts.claim: It was decided during training that Devna would go first through the portal
facts.quote: During training they had decided it made most since for Devna to go first.

facts.claim: The Home Anchor is a small cylinder durable enough not to break and strand Myor
facts.quote: It was durable, Devna knew because she had spent nearly eleven months redesigning it to ensure it wouldn’t accidentally break and strand Myor if anything forced them to split up.

facts.claim: The Home Anchor is secured in Myor's belt pouch
facts.quote: Myor said, patting the belt pouch the Home Anchor was in.

facts.claim: Jackson is a heavyset elf who dresses impeccably
facts.quote: A heavyset elf, he dressed impeccably and was proud to lead this expedition.

facts.claim: Jackson pushed hard to make the expedition happen
facts.quote: they’d never have made it this far if Jackson hadn’t pushed so hard for it.

facts.claim: Jackson was overruled by Devna and Myor in naming the Wayfarer Sigil
facts.quote: Jackson was just sore that her and Myor overruled him in naming it.

facts.claim: Myor is a Ratfolk on the taller side, just over five feet
facts.quote: he was on the taller side of the Ratfolk at just over five feet

facts.claim: Myor is a silent caster who needs no vocals or gestures to control his magic
facts.quote: he was a silent caster. It was a point of pride that he was skilled enough to not need vocal or gestures to aid his control.

facts.claim: Myor carries the Home Anchor
facts.quote: He pulled out the Home Anchor, a small cylinder that fit easily into his smaller hands

facts.claim: Myor prefers water-related descriptions when describing magic
facts.quote: Myor himself tended to prefer water related descriptions.

facts.claim: Myor bonded best with Devna during the initial training to select the final candidates
facts.quote: Devna had bonded best with Myor during the initial training to select the final candidates.

facts.claim: Ratfolk prefer a vegetarian diet but can eat almost anything
facts.quote: While they preferred a vegetarian diet, they could eat almost anything.

facts.claim: Ratfolk are wily, flexible in thinking, and social
facts.quote: They were wily, flexible in thinking, and social.

facts.claim: The forest on the other side of the portal has giant trees, thick undergrowth, high humidity, and a night-like darkness under a canopy
facts.quote: The trees were giant, stretching far above with the lowermost branches only just barely within the light spell.

facts.claim: The forest's magic feels heavy, like syrup, to Myor
facts.quote: But the magic here is… heavy.

facts.claim: A deliberately cleared and likely maintained dirt road runs through the forest near the portal
facts.quote: the undergrowth made way for dirt path. It wasn’t paved, but even from this distance it was clear the undergrowth had been deliberately cleared and was likely maintained.

the-giant-forest.name: the giant forest
the-giant-forest.role: destination world reached through the portal

facts.claim: The portal frame is a permanent installation that finetunes portal crafting and acts as an anchor for return
facts.quote: a permanent installation that finetuned the portal crafting that would allow them to travel beyond their own world and act as an anchor to allow them to return.

facts.claim: The expedition opened several portals in the three months before this one, but this was the first anyone traveled through
facts.quote: They’d opened several portals over the last three months, but this would be the first one anyone actually traveled through.

facts.claim: The Wayfarer Sigil is a cylinder similar to the Home Anchor that serves a similar function through different means
facts.quote: Both items served a similar function, though through different means

facts.claim: The Wayfarer Sigil is secured in Devna's belt pouch
facts.quote: Devna grinned, patting her own belt pouch where a very similar cylinder to the Home Anchor was located.
